title: Psychedelic Praying Mantis
description: A vibrant green praying mantis with large purple compound eyes stands on a white grid surface, holding a glowing green orb with a spiral pattern that is splashing into a colorful liquid pool. The background features swirling psychedelic patterns in teal, purple, pink and yellow with wavy ribbons and floating colored petals.
prompt: A highly detailed green praying mantis with iridescent wings and large purple eyes stands on a white grid plane, one foreleg touching a glowing green orb covered in spiral patterns that is splashing into a swirling pool of turquoise, green and yellow liquid. Psychedelic swirling patterns in purple, teal and pink fill the background with wavy colorful ribbons and floating oval petals, vibrant fantasy art style.
